scope: Third web repair batch; no firmware image build, flash or firmware-slot commit

findings.observed: conn_diag and amas_ssd_cd run, but queried local historical databases have zero bytes; BE98 requests diagnostic mode 2. The original chart represents missing history as zero.
findings.resolution: Add an independent passive local sampler; do not change role, controller diagnostic policy or radio configuration.

findings.observed: UI calls get_diag_raw_data.cgi but stock httpd has no route. Existing get_diag_content_data raw branch uses ts=0, duration=0, point=0 for libcodb last-24h query.
findings.resolution: Compatibility adapter filters actual raw results by requested time and sorts chronologically; no sampled averages substituted. Native event collection remains incomplete on this node.

findings.observed: First raw query containing SQL NULL triggered a httpds exit; watchdog restarted HTTPS (PID 4060 -> 15731). libcodb passes SQL NULL directly to json_object_new_string.
findings.resolution: History schema enforces non-NULL sentinel values; frontend renders sentinels as missing data. Future source patch adds three NULL guards.
findings.impact: One HTTPS service restart during testing. Same device boot ID, hostapd 9278 and cfg_client 6858 throughout; no router reboot or Wi-Fi service restart.

delivered: Dashboard and Traffic Monitor show per-interface receive/transmit rates, including bond0 and internal AI-board eth.ai without summing bond members
Per-band authorized link history; MLO links are not claimed to be unique physical devices
WiFi Insight passive busy/OBSS/NOPKT history, measured noise and observed channel/bandwidth changes
30-minute, 6-hour and 24-hour display ranges; samples continue when page is closed
NULL, counter-reset, interface-replacement, outage and disabled-radio handling
Fourteen persistent version-locked web overlays; history start/stop integrated with existing apply/rollback scripts

collector.stored_identifiers: interface names only; no client MAC addresses or SSIDs stored in the history database

validation.counter_fixture: scripts/verify-node-history.py passed first sample, real delta, interface replacement, counter reset, long gap, radio disable, NULL-free API, and 24h pruning
validation.source_patch: patch --dry-run passed against pinned upstream libcodb source; not compiled
validation.browser: Native Chrome verified real curves, traffic interface switching to eth.ai, 24h range selection, 6GHz selection and independent Traffic Monitor entry. Router-origin JavaScript errors were not observed in inspected logs.

limits: Full FFT spectrum/classified interference remains unimplemented; AirIQ stock startup requests 3+1 PHY scan mode and may restart 2.4GHz on scan failure. Passive chanim reads do not do this.
NOPKT is undecoded energy occupancy, not identified non-WiFi interferer proof.
Traffic is kernel interface counters; hardware offload coverage depends on the driver and is not billing-grade WAN traffic.
Channel changes are inferred between minute samples; changes within the interval and vendor DFS/change reasons are not reconstructed.
Startup configuration is persistent, but no router reboot was performed to test it.

manifest.scope: Authenticated local node web UI; no network-role or authentication changes
